translations.text: George went to the assembly with a great host, from the borderland with a great many people.

He went to the court circle, to a mighty assembly. That assembly was most famous and most dear to God: he gave up the kingdom of the world and won the kingdom of heaven. The famous count George did this himself.
Then all the many kings tried to entice him. They wanted to turn him from his faith, but he would not listen to them.
George's mind was firm. He did not listen to them, as I hope for good, but he carried out everything he had prayed to God for. Saint George did this himself.
Then they quickly sentenced him to prison. Beautiful angels went there with him.
There he found two women and saved their lives. Then he made a meal for them, beautifully and in holiness. George truly worked that miracle there.
Then George prayed, and the Lord granted him everything. The Lord granted him everything that George prayed to him for:
he made the dumb speak, the deaf hear, the blind see, and the lame walk.
A pillar had stood there for many years, and at once leaves sprang out of it. George truly worked that miracle there.
The powerful man began to grow very angry at this. Dacian raged and was wondrously angry at it.
He said that George was a sorcerer. He ordered George to be seized, ordered him to be stripped, and ordered him to be struck hard with a wondrously sharp sword.
This I know, and it is all true: George rose up again there, George rose up again there, and he preached well there. George put the heathen men utterly to shame.
The powerful man began to grow very angry at this. Then he ordered George to be bound and wound onto a wheel.
Truly I tell you, they broke him into ten pieces. This I know, and it is all true: George rose up again there.
George rose up again there, and he preached well there. George put the heathen men utterly to shame.
Then he ordered George to be seized and to be flogged hard. They ordered him to be ground up and burnt completely to powder.
They threw him into the well. He was a blessed son. They rolled a great many stones over it. They began to walk around him and told George to rise up.
George did a great deed there, as he truly always does. This I know, and it is all true: George rose up again there:
George rose up again there, and the splendid one [?] sprang out at once. George put the heathen men utterly to shame.
George ordered a dead man to stand up. He told him to come there to him and told him to speak at once.
Then he said, believe it, how [?] they were lost, all deceived by the devil. Saint George himself made this known to us.
Then he went to the chamber of the queen. He began to teach her, and she began to listen to him.
Alexandra was secretly devoted [?]. She at once hastened to do good and to give away her [?] (sanc).
There she gave away her treasure. That will help her for many years, from eternity to eternity, so that they [?] show her mercy. The lord Saint George himself won this by his prayers.
George raised his hand, and Apollo trembled. He gave his command over the hound of hell, and at once it went down into the abyss.
